name: worklog
description: Logs every Claude Code session into one readable file per day: your messages, plus the reports, tickets, PRs and kubectl actions from the replies.

log_dir.title: Log folder
log_dir.description: Where daily logs are saved. Pick a folder that syncs between your own Macs (iCloud Drive, Google Drive, Dropbox). Don't pick one shared with other people: logs hold your full messages. Tip: /worklog:setup opens a Finder picker instead.
